verdict.rationale: Slack's AI features page states directly that AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and deliver daily recaps, which matches the story exactly. The 'Today' intelligent briefing adds a further catch-up surface. The evidence is limited to a short marketing claim, with no in-depth documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how channel/thread summaries and recaps work (scope, configuration, plan availability), independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.
